rules.name: cloud/aws_cloudtrail_stop_logging.yml
rules.content:
title: AWS CloudTrail Logging Stopped Or Deleted
id: fa696775-606c-48fd-bf17-38d033c6d565
status: stable
description: Detects someone stopping or deleting a CloudTrail trail to hide activity.
author: Sigma Forge samples
date: 2026-11-11
tags:
  - attack.defense-impairment
  - attack.t1685.002
logsource:
  product: aws
  service: cloudtrail
detection:
  selection:
    eventSource: 'cloudtrail.amazonaws.com'
    eventName:
      - 'StopLogging'
      - 'DeleteTrail'
      - 'UpdateTrail'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Planned changes by cloud admins
level: high

rules.name: cloud/azure_signin_impossible_mfa_fatigue.yml
rules.content:
title: Many MFA Denials For One User
id: 1f6e7585-97d7-4ee6-a459-75ef5f076928
status: experimental
description: Detects Azure sign in logs where MFA was denied, a sign of push fatigue attacks.
author: Sigma Forge samples
date: 2026-11-11
tags:
  - attack.credential-access
  - attack.t1621
logsource:
  product: azure
  service: signinlogs
detection:
  selection:
    ResultType: 500121
    ResultDescription|contains: 'denied'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Users who miss the prompt
level: medium

rules.name: collections/global_action_net_commands.yml
rules.content:
action: global

  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\net.exe'
      - '\net1.exe'
author: Sigma Forge samples
date: 2026-11-11
tags:
  - attack.discovery
status: test
level: medium
---
title: Net Command Lists Domain Admins
id: c0908088-f0be-4c3e-8cbd-579b46e9e71c
description: Uses the global part above plus its own selection.
tags:
  - attack.t1069.002
detection:
  selection_cli:

---

id: 0a74cca4-5bf3-4c99-8c80-55e4cf252710
description: Uses the same global part with a different selection.
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1136.001
detection:

    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'user'
      - '/add'
  condition: all of selection_*

id: b06c5bce-c402-491c-83f7-4778bde7ae0c
status: test

date: 2026-11-11

date: 2026-11-11

logsource:
  product: linux
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_clear:

rules.content:
title: Shadow Copies Deleted With Vssadmin Or Wmic
id: 9a8b7c6d-5e4f-4321-8765-0fedcba98765
status: stable
description: Detects deletion of volume shadow copies, a common step before ransomware encryption.
author: Sigma Forge samples
date: 2026-11-11
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1490
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_vssadmin:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  selection_wmic:
    Image|endswith: '\wmic.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'shadowcopy'
      - 'delete'
  condition: 1 of selection_*
falsepositives:
  - Backup software maintenance
level: critical

rules.name: windows/proc_creation_whoami_recon.yml
rules.content:
title: Whoami With Privilege Or Group Flags
id: 63c870cb-0408-488b-a211-1e386a937b92
status: stable
description: Detects whoami used to list privileges or groups, often run right after initial access.
author: Sigma Forge samples
date: 2026-11-11
tags:
  - attack.discovery
  - attack.t1033
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\whoami.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'whoami.exe'
  selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|windash:
      - ' -priv'
      - ' -groups'
      - ' -all'
  condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:
  - Admin scripts
level: informational

rules.name: windows/ps_module_invoke_mimikatz.yml

rules.name: windows/ps_script_amsi_bypass.yml

id: 4d5e6f70-8192-4a3b-bc4d-5e6f708192a3
status: experimental
description: Detects common AMSI bypass strings in PowerShell script block logs (event 4104).

rules.name: windows/registry_set_run_key.yml
rules.content:
title: Run Key Set To Program In Public Or Temp Folder
id: 3c2b1a09-8f7e-4d6c-a5b4-c3d2e1f0a9b8
status: experimental
description: Detects a Run or RunOnce registry value pointing to a program in a user writable folder.
author: Sigma Forge samples
date: 2026-11-11
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1547.001
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: registry_set
detection:
  selection_key:
    TargetObject|contains:
      - '\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\'
      - '\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce\'
  selection_path:
    Details|contains:
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
      - '\Windows\Temp\'
  condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:
  - Installers that run from temp folders
level: medium

status: stable

author: Sigma Forge samples
date: 2026-11-11

  - attack.t1021.002
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1569.002
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: system

logsource:

  category: wmi_event

  selection:

level: high
